# Low Water Finds

*The ligators of the Reed Beds churn the mud, and the mud gives things up. Robin wants the reed beds cleared so he can hunt at low water there, and his best find shown to Jasper.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Defeat 30 [Reed Ligator](../monsters/reed_ligator.md) in [The Reed Beds](../maps/reed_beds.md)
2. Talk to [Jasper](../npcs/jasper.md)

## Rewards

- 5,060 EXP
- 620 mesos
- [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +80 standing with [Robin](../npcs/robin.md)
